problems: Cars belong to many private owners, so there is no single source of truth for who owns what.
Records live in notebooks, WhatsApp chats and memory, which leads to lost records and disputes.
Nobody tracks when a car leaves the stand, which means missing vehicles and theft risk.
There are no formal agreements with owners, so price and commission disputes follow.
Dealers have no clear view of what is selling, what is stuck and what money is coming in.
solutions: Photos (at least one is required), VIN, price and a clear status: available, out, reserved, sold or returned.
Every check-out and check-in is logged with the purpose, the person responsible and the expected return.
Income statements, profit per vehicle and monthly breakdowns, exported as PDF, JPG or Excel.
Staff work inside a dealer's account with limited permissions. Investors and partners see their earnings, never the dealer's costs.
Buyers search by keyword, dealer, company or dealer ID (with voice search), save favourites and book appointments.
Receipts, invoices and proformas in one tap, shared straight to WhatsApp with phone numbers formatted automatically.
Web, Android and iOS from one codebase
Next.js and Capacitor power the apps, FastAPI powers the backend, and push notifications keep everyone informed.
accounts: Runs inventory, staff, sales, finances, appointments and a public profile.
Handles day-to-day inventory and sales within the limits the dealer sets.
Tracks assigned vehicles and earnings through a revenue-share view.
Browses the marketplace, saves favourites, books appointments and contacts dealers.
Approves dealers, moderates the feed and watches platform-wide analytics.
